headline: Fuel prices jump: Govt hikes all fuel prices by Tk 20 per litre
summary: The price increase has sparked outrage among transport workers and warnings from economists about rising inflation.
details: The government has increased the price of all types of fuel by Tk 20 per litre. This sudden hike has caused widespread dissatisfaction among transport drivers and operators.
State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources stated that the price adjustment was unavoidable due to the ongoing crisis in the Middle East.
Transport workers, including the Jatri Kalyan Samity, have called for the immediate withdrawal of the price hike, arguing it places an unfair burden on them.
Political parties including Jamaat-e-Islami and AB Party have announced protests against the move, claiming it will worsen the existing inflationary pressure on common people.
Economists warn that this increase may prolong inflationary pressure, making essential goods and services more expensive for the general public.
Rizvi Hassan of Jamaat-e-Islami claimed that even after the hike, they are bearing a loss of Tk 70 per litre of diesel, highlighting the struggle of transport operators.
caption:
Fuel prices just jumped by Tk 20 per litre. Drivers are protesting and economists warn of a new inflation spike.

The government has increased the price of all types of fuel by Tk 20 per litre. This sudden hike has caused widespread dissatisfaction among transport drivers and operators.

State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources stated that the price adjustment was unavoidable due to the ongoing crisis in the Middle East.

Transport workers, including the Jatri Kalyan Samity, have called for the immediate withdrawal of the price hike, arguing it places an unfair burden on them.

Political parties including Jamaat-e-Islami and AB Party have announced protests against the move, claiming it will worsen the existing inflationary pressure on common people.

Economists warn that this increase may prolong inflationary pressure, making essential goods and services more expensive for the general public.

Rizvi Hassan of Jamaat-e-Islami claimed that even after the hike, they are bearing a loss of Tk 70 per litre of diesel, highlighting the struggle of transport operators.

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Kabaddi: [[Bangladesh one win away from semis]] after edging Chinese Taipei
headline: Kabaddi: Bangladesh one win away from semis after edging Chinese Taipei
summary: A nerve-wracking 48-47 victory puts the team top of Group A, bringing them closer to their first Asian Games bronze since 2006.
details: Bangladesh secured a thrilling 48-47 win over Chinese Taipei in the men's kabaddi event at the Asian Games in Japan.
The victory marks back-to-back wins for Bangladesh, propelling them to the top of Group A.
The team now needs only one more win from their remaining two matches against Japan and India to reach the semifinals.
A semifinal spot would guarantee at least a bronze medal, which would be the team's first since the 2006 Doha Asian Games.
Bangladesh led 24-20 at halftime, but Chinese Taipei fought back to level the match at 37-37.
Holding their nerve in the closing stages, Bangladesh managed an all-out on Chinese Taipei to regain the lead and secure the win by a single point.
Bangladesh will face Japan tomorrow and India on September 23.
caption:
A single point decided it! Bangladesh edges Chinese Taipei 48-47 to move within one win of the Asian Games semifinals.

Bangladesh secured a thrilling 48-47 win over Chinese Taipei in the men's kabaddi event at the Asian Games in Japan.

The victory marks back-to-back wins for Bangladesh, propelling them to the top of Group A.

The team now needs only one more win from their remaining two matches against Japan and India to reach the semifinals.

A semifinal spot would guarantee at least a bronze medal, which would be the team's first since the 2006 Doha Asian Games.

Bangladesh led 24-20 at halftime, but Chinese Taipei fought back to level the match at 37-37.

Holding their nerve in the closing stages, Bangladesh managed an all-out on Chinese Taipei to regain the lead and secure the win by a single point.

Bangladesh will face Japan tomorrow and India on September 23.
